instruction: Access the Slide Master by clicking View > Master > Slide Master, locate the slide number, and change its font color to blue

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide number color to blue in the slide master. The evaluator uses the existing check_page_number_colors function which parses the slide master XML to verify the color of the page number placeholder. Verified that check_page_number_colors supports 'blue' color check.
metadata.verification: The check_page_number_colors function from slides.py (lines 876-920) parses the slide master XML to find the color of the page number placeholder. It checks the second-to-last solidFill/srgbClr element in the slide master and verifies it matches the expected color using threshold-based RGB comparison (red: R > G+50 and R > B+50, blue: B > G+50 and B > R+50, green: G > R+50 and G > B+50, black: R < 50 and G < 50 and B < 50).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file retrieves the PPTX file from VM with proper postconfig to save file (Ctrl+S) before retrieval
Metric logic is correct: check_page_number_colors parses slide master XML and extracts color from the second-to-last solidFill/srgbClr element, which corresponds to page number placeholder
Color detection logic is appropriate: uses threshold-based RGB comparison (B > G+50 and B > R+50) to identify blue color
Parameter handling is correct: function uses 'rules' parameter directly (color = rules['color']) without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules') or expected.get('type')
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (slide number color changed to blue in slide master)
Expected value is semantically correct: 'blue' matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig is appropriate: activates window and saves file to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Data flow is correct: file path retrieved by getter matches what metric expects, and metric can parse PPTX XML correctly
